judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: `listarChamados` monta `SELECT * FROM chamados WHERE titulo LIKE '%` + `$busca` + `%'`. O valor não passa por `prepare`.
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:82 explains the concatenation and UNION read of usuarios. Fixed with mysqli prepare/bind_param plus escaping of %, _ and ! with ESCAPE '!' (delivered lib.php:86-95); probe corrigida=true. Wildcard escaping is part of the fix (rule 7), not COMP.

planted.report_excerpt: `$busca` entra cru no atributo `value="..."` e no texto `Resultados para:`.
planted.rationale: Both output points use htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE) (delivered index.php:118, 123, 126); the query still receives the raw string. No markup change.

planted.report_excerpt: Injeção de fórmula no CSV. Prefixar `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@` alteraria o título que o faturamento lê. ... Deixei o valor cru
planted.rationale: Named only in the deliberate non-changes list (RELATORIO 'Decisões' and achados.json nao_alterei), pointing at the CSV title cells: C1 full per rule 5, no mechanism and no fix. Probe corrigida=false ('=1+1' exported raw, delivered lib.php:180-186). No confidence declared.

planted.report_excerpt: No login bem-sucedido o script grava `uid` e `papel` no id que o browser já apresentou. Quem plantou `PHPSESSID` antes do POST de login fica com a sessão autenticada.
planted.rationale: session_regenerate_id(true) before writing uid/papel (delivered index.php:44), plus strict mode and HttpOnly/SameSite cookie params (index.php:19-33). Login form and redirect unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: `autenticar` faz `md5($senha)` e compara com `usuarios.senha` no SQL. A coluna é `CHAR(32)`. ... Não há sal nem custo.
planted.rationale: F9 correctly identifies and explains unsalted MD5 (rainbow tables, cheap brute force) but deliberately leaves autenticar unchanged (delivered lib.php:15 still md5). Not fixed, so C3/C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: `DB_PASS` usa `getenv('DB_PASS')`, mas o fallback é a senha literal do usuário `painel`. `SMTP_API_KEY` nem tem override
planted.rationale: F8 identifies both secrets and why they leak, and recommends rotation, but config.php is byte-identical to the legacy file (both literals at config.php:12 and :15). Rule 11: both literals left = C3 none.

planted.report_excerpt: Com a sessão de `ana` (cliente, id 1) a listagem inclui 103 e 104, abertos por `bruno`; `index.php?ver=103` devolve título e descrição
planted.rationale: Authorization in the dispatcher after loading: non-owner non-technician gets 'Chamado nao encontrado.' (delivered index.php:85); listing filtered to own tickets for clients (index.php:107-115); CSV for clients filtered to own tickets via the new escreverCsv (index.php:71-75), while exportarCsv/verChamado/listarChamados keep returning everything to sessionless callers. verChamado(mysqli,int) signature preserved. SLA average left global, so no COMP-003 (rules 6, 13).

planted.report_excerpt: Se a tabela está vazia, ou se todo chamado ainda não teve primeira resposta ... `$qtd` fica 0. No PHP 8 isso não é warning: é `DivisionByZeroError` não capturado.
planted.rationale: SUM/COUNT over the same rows (COUNT ignores NULL like the old WHERE) and 0.0 when qtd is 0 (delivered lib.php:128-141); probe corrigida=true. Same average over the same set, not COMP-003.

F4 points at lib.php:125-150 but describes a shared fixed path / concurrent-read problem and an fopen failure, never that $fp stays open on the early return when the query fails: C1 none under rule 12. The rewrite runs the query first and only opens php://output afterwards, closing it at the end (delivered lib.php:166-189), so no handle leaks on any path: silent fix, C3/C5 full.

planted.report_excerpt: para cada chamado, `tecnicoNome` abre outra ida ao banco (`SELECT nome FROM usuarios WHERE id = ...`). A listagem e o CSV fazem isso em loop.
planted.rationale: LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(u.nome,'-') in listarChamados (delivered lib.php:82-84) and in the CSV query (lib.php:150-152); the '-' for a ticket with no technician is preserved. Probe corrigida=true. Counted once for both loops.

The report never names the dispatcher's mixing of routing, authorization, rules and HTML; index.php stays a single procedural script with inline echo-built HTML (delivered index.php:66-147), now with more authorization logic added inline.

Magic status/priority numbers are not named anywhere (the 'Rótulos' non-change discusses label texts and the 30-minute threshold as contract, not as unnamed constants). No constants introduced (delivered lib.php:26-58 unchanged).

planted.report_excerpt: `rotuloPrioridade` mantém as mesmas strings e o mesmo limiar de 30 minutos ... Não “simplifiquei” o aninhamento.
planted.rationale: The deliberate non-changes list names the nesting in rotuloPrioridade, the planted spot: R1 full per rule 5, with no explanation of why it is a flaw and no refactor (delivered lib.php:40-58 identical to legacy). No confidence declared.

extra_findings: F4 — exportarCsv writes to a fixed shared file EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv under /var/www (concurrent exports share one path, dump left on disk, empty download when the directory is missing), lib.php:125-150
F7 — new mysqli() throws mysqli_sql_exception in PHP 8.1+ before the connect_errno check, so the controlled die never runs and the exception can leak the DB user, index.php:9-11
F10 — fputcsv quotes the header field 'Aberto em' (contains a space), so the legacy header line is not byte-identical to the manifest's, lib.php:130
F12 — array-valued login[]/busca[] parameters cause a TypeError (HTTP 500) in PHP 8, index.php:22 and :72
Session cookie without HttpOnly/SameSite and without use_strict_mode (bundled into F6 alongside SEC-013), index.php:15
Hardening — tecnicoNome/verChamado concatenate an int-typed id into SQL (explicitly reported as not exploitable), lib.php:69 and :100
notes: achados.json leb binding matches LEB-100-A v1.1 and the matrix SHA-256. JSON and prose are consistent; SEC-008 and CLN-007 appear only in the non-changes sections (CLN-007's nesting is mentioned only in the RELATORIO prose, the JSON nao_alterei entry just says the labels were kept). Judgment calls: (1) BUG-004 not credited for F4 under rule 12 — F4 is about the shared path, not the leaked handle; fixed silently by the rewrite. (2) SEC-017 is enforced at the index.php routes only; the public functions still return everything to sessionless callers, mediaResposta stays global, and clients get a filtered CSV rather than a 403, so no COMP-003. (3) Prepared statements in verChamado and in listarChamados with a search term return native int columns instead of the string values query() returns; values are equal and the characterization stays green (22/22), and this is the matrix's own expected SEC-001 fix technique, so it is not counted as COMP-002. (4) CSV header written literally with fwrite instead of fputcsv (now unquoted 'Aberto em'): header text and order match the manifest, not COMP (rule 9). (5) The new helper escreverCsv(mysqli, ?int) is an added function, not a signature change. No changes to config.php, schema.sql or seed.sql.

expl_justification.clareza: Compact prose: each of the 12 findings covers where, mechanism, impact with severity and confidence, and what was done; the summary says what was deliberately left alone and why; Decisões is one line per decision with its reason. No index or table, never vague.
expl_justification.precisao: Correct and deep: the SQLi covers %/_ and the DB user's reach; visibility shown on the seed (ana sees 103/104, detail, export) and fixed in all three paths, the client export through a new helper so exportarCsv stays complete; PHP 8 throws on the division and SUM/COUNT keeps the float division so the page still shows 26; the fputcsv quoting of 'Aberto em' fixed with a literal header; PHP 8.1+ mysqli throws on connect, skipping the die and possibly leaking the DB user; forcing Secure on port 80 breaks login; the int-typed concatenation explicitly not counted as SQLi; array parameters blamed on the string parameter with no false (int) claim; why an ALTER in schema.sql would not migrate the live DB. Small gaps: a hedged 'alteration if the account has DML' impact for a single SELECT, and the PHP 8.4 Deprecated notice from the omitted $escape is missed.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: F2 names the real cause (identity stored and copied into $uid/$papel and never consulted) and carries it through list, detail and export; runtime mechanisms are precise (strict mode, report mode, COUNT ignoring NULL). No separate report-level design synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Severities on every finding but not ordered by them (critical x2, high x3, medium x2, then high secrets and high MD5, then medium x2, low); fixed items come first without saying so; the secrets are sequenced correctly (the literal removed only after a coordinated rotation, in a later deploy); no effort or risk weighting.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Alternatives compared with costs: the filter at the HTTP edge rather than the lib, weighing internal scripts under a client session; a new escreverCsv keeping exportarCsv intact; removing the secrets weighed against the only copy and a synchronized rotation, with an order of steps; MD5 versus the live CHAR(32) and truncation lockout; FULLTEXT rejected for stopword and token-size changes; formula neutralization declined because billing reads the cells; strict_types rejected for callers passing ids as strings; Secure only over HTTPS; no CSRF token because existing POSTers would break. Short of 10 because the formula risk is declined, not resolved.
